weapons.specialPt: Atordoante; reduz graduação e Iniciativa sem Destreza 3

weapons.name: Staff
weapons.specialPt: Duas mãos; derrubar; alcance corpo a corpo

weapons.name: Stake

weapons.specialPt: Ataque localizado -3; exige 5 pontos de dano para empalar

weapons.name: Stun gun
weapons.special: Stunning, doesn't apply successes as damage
weapons.specialPt: Atordoante; sucessos não aumentam o dano

weapons.name: Spear
weapons.specialPt: Duas mãos sem Força 3; alcance corpo a corpo; arremessável

weapons.name: Bow, compound
weapons.specialPt: Alcance baseado em Força + Tamanho + Arquearia

weapons.name: Bow, neolithic

weapons.specialPt: Alcance baseado em Força + Tamanho + Atletismo; menos eficaz contra armadura

weapons.name: Crossbow

weapons.name: Javelin

weapons.name: Sling, neolithic

equipment.name: Ferramentas automotivas básicas
equipment.effect: Permitem reparos automotivos comuns.
equipment.effectEn: Required for ordinary automotive repairs; trained characters can handle mundane issues without a roll when time is not a factor.

equipment.name: Garagem automotiva
equipment.effect: Oficina equipada para reparos e modificações complexos.
equipment.effectEn: Required for involved repairs, major damage, and complex modifications, which use an extended Intelligence + Crafts action.

equipment.name: Cache oculto
equipment.effect: Esconde e protege objetos; o bônus também penaliza buscas.
equipment.effectEn: Holds two items of its Size plus reasonable smaller items. Its bonus aids concealment and penalizes searches; it cannot exceed half its parent object's Size.

equipment.name: Headset de comunicação
equipment.effect: Auxilia esforços coordenados entre usuários treinados.
equipment.effectEn: Grants its bonus to coordinated efforts by practiced users; in teamwork it applies only to the final roll. Obstructions may require Wits + Composure.

equipment.name: Kit de cena de crime
equipment.effect: Auxilia Investigação e permite transportar evidências adequadamente.
equipment.effectEn: Adds to Investigation and allows evidence to be moved and examined properly offsite.

equipment.name: Kit de códigos
equipment.effect: Cria e interpreta uma cifra; o bônus penaliza tentativas de quebrá-la.
equipment.effectEn: Creates and interprets a cipher for a specific audience; its bonus penalizes attempts to crack it without the key.

equipment.name: Software de invasão
equipment.effect: Ajuda a romper senhas e sistemas e cria uma camada contra rastreamento.
equipment.effectEn: Adds to breaching passwords and firewalls. Tracing requires one action to identify the software and another to find its source.

equipment.name: Gravador digital
equipment.effect: Registra sons discretamente e ajuda a perceber fala ou ruídos.
equipment.effectEn: Adds to detecting or recording speech and sounds and to concealment; it can contest attempts to obscure discussion or mask noise.

equipment.name: Fita adesiva
equipment.effect: Ajuda Ofícios, reforça objetos ou restringe com penalidade para escapar.
equipment.effectEn: Adds +1 to suitable Crafts actions, can add 1 Durability, or restrains with −3 to escape rolls against its Structure.

equipment.name: Kit de primeiros socorros
equipment.effect: Permite estabilizar ferimentos e pode melhorar rolagens de tratamento.
equipment.effectEn: The basic kit permits stabilization; the advanced kit also grants +1 to treatment rolls.

equipment.name: Lanterna
equipment.effect: Reduz penalidades de escuridão, auxilia buscas e pode cegar por um turno.
equipment.effectEn: Offsets darkness penalties and aids searches. Dexterity + Athletics versus Stamina can blind a target for one turn, or two with acute senses.

equipment.name: Bastão luminoso
equipment.effect: Ilumina uma pequena área por horas, inclusive sob água.
equipment.effectEn: Functions as a soft, waterproof light source for hours but cannot blind a target.

equipment.name: Rastreador GPS
equipment.effect: Permite acompanhar a posição de um dispositivo em área com sinal.
equipment.effectEn: Tracks a GPS-enabled device while it has service; caves, tunnels, and sewers may block it.

equipment.name: Software keylogger
equipment.effect: Registra teclas e auxilia invasão de rede ou busca de dados.
equipment.effectEn: Records keystrokes; its bonus aids installing it, breaching a network, or finding captured data.

equipment.name: Luminol
equipment.effect: Revela traços de fluidos corporais e auxilia rastreamento e reconstrução.
equipment.effectEn: Reveals faint bodily-fluid traces for about 30 seconds; adds to tracking and reconstructing crime scenes.

equipment.name: Multiferramenta
equipment.effect: Permite diversas ações simples quando faltam ferramentas próprias.
equipment.effectEn: Permits many simple Crafts and related actions without dedicated tools; as a weapon it deals 0L with −1 to hit.

equipment.name: Computador pessoal
equipment.effect: Auxilia tarefas digitais conforme sua qualidade.
equipment.effectEn: Adds +1 to +4 to appropriate digital tasks according to Availability and quality.

equipment.name: Smartphone
equipment.effect: Concentra comunicação, pesquisa, registro e diversos aplicativos.
equipment.effectEn: Performs communication, research, recording, navigation, recognition, and other portable computing tasks; high-end models grant the larger bonus.

equipment.name: Efeitos especiais
equipment.effect: Produz ilusões e distrações convincentes até haver motivo para suspeita.
equipment.effectEn: Adds to creating practical illusions and distractions. Witnesses initially believe the effect unless given reason to scrutinize it.

equipment.name: Equipamento de vigilância
equipment.effect: Detecta e registra intrusos; permite disputar tentativas de evasão.
equipment.effectEn: Automatically notices and records an intruder who is unaware of it. Evasion contests Dexterity + Stealth against the installer's Intelligence + Computer or Crafts plus the bonus.

equipment.name: Kit de sobrevivência
equipment.effect: Reduz níveis ambientais e auxilia ações de sobrevivência.
equipment.effectEn: Basic gear grants +1 and reduces environment level by 1; advanced gear grants +2 and reduces a chosen environment by 2. It cannot mitigate level 4.

equipment.name: Talco
equipment.effect: Revela passagens e presença de entidades invisíveis.
equipment.effectEn: Reveals tracks and invisible presences. Crossing a dusted entrance without a trace requires five successes on Dexterity + Stealth.

equipment.name: Tinta ultravioleta
equipment.effect: Permite escrever mensagens invisíveis sem luz UV.
equipment.effectEn: Creates messages and marks invisible to the naked eye and readable under ultraviolet light.

equipment.name: Aríete
equipment.effect: Ação de equipe para derrubar barreiras, ignorando Durabilidade 2.
equipment.effectEn: Supports a teamwork action by up to four participants to breach a barrier and ignores 2 Durability.

equipment.name: Armadilha de urso
equipment.effect: Causa três de dano letal, ignora proteção e prende a perna.
equipment.effectEn: Deals 3 lethal damage, ignores 2 Armor or Durability, and traps a leg. Escape uses Strength + Stamina penalized by its bonus; failure deals 1L.

equipment.name: Estrepes
equipment.effect: Causam dano letal e dificultam movimento seguro.
equipment.effectEn: Crossing deals 1 lethal and ignores 1 Armor or Durability. Safe passage uses Dexterity + Athletics at −2 and half Speed.

equipment.name: Roupa de camuflagem
equipment.effect: Auxilia Furtividade no ambiente para o qual foi preparada.
equipment.effectEn: Adds to remaining unnoticed when its pattern matches the environment.

equipment.name: Equipamento de escalada
equipment.effect: Auxilia escalada e limita quedas quando instalado corretamente.
equipment.effectEn: Adds to Strength + Athletics for climbing; properly installed with Wits + Athletics, it limits falls to 10 feet.

equipment.name: Pé de cabra
equipment.effect: Cria alavanca, ignora Durabilidade 2 e também serve como arma.
equipment.effectEn: Adds to leverage actions, ignores 2 Durability while prying, and can also use the Crowbar weapon profile.

equipment.name: Supressor de arma de fogo
equipment.effect: Melhora disparos curtos e dificulta localizar o atirador, reduzindo dano em um.
equipment.effectEn: At short range, reduces weapon damage by 1 and adds +2 attack dice. Identifying the shot or locating the shooter suffers −2.

equipment.name: Máscara de gás
equipment.effect: Protege contra toxinas aéreas e amplia rolagens contra agentes fortes.
equipment.effectEn: Negates minor airborne toxins and adds +5 to rolls against powerful agents.

equipment.name: Algemas
equipment.effect: Restringem um alvo e dificultam ações manuais e tentativas de fuga.
equipment.effectEn: Applied through a grapple. Escape uses Strength + Stamina −4 or Dexterity + Athletics −4; manual actions suffer −4, or −2 when cuffed in front.

equipment.name: Kit de gazuas
equipment.effect: Permite abrir fechaduras mecânicas e auxilia Destreza + Furto.
equipment.effectEn: Allows mechanical locks to be picked without a roll when time permits and Larceny is at least 1; otherwise adds to Dexterity + Larceny.

equipment.name: Óculos de visão noturna
equipment.effect: Eliminam penalidades por cegueira em baixa luz; luz intensa pode cegar.
equipment.effectEn: Removes penalties for acting blind in low light; bright light may temporarily blind the wearer.

equipment.name: Spray de pimenta
equipment.effect: Ataque curto que Atordoa e impõe penalidade até lavar os olhos.
equipment.effectEn: Dexterity + Athletics or Firearms attack at one yard per range band. On a hit, inflicts Stun and −5 to actions, reduced by rinsing the eyes.

equipment.name: Corda
equipment.effect: Auxilia Ofícios, escalada, amarração e outras tarefas apropriadas.
equipment.effectEn: Adds to appropriate Crafts, climbing, binding, and similar actions; bindings resist escape with the rope's Durability and Structure.
